features.title: Autonomy fake-runner CI smoke
features.description: Structural test proves a scratch --autonomy install can run midas-autopilot tick with --runner=fake without cloud credentials.
acceptance_criteria: WHEN npm test runs on CI, the autonomy smoke test SHALL pass without network tokens.
WHEN the smoke fixture completes, MIDAS_AUTOPILOT tick output SHALL show a reconciled no-op or fake effect.

features.title: Ship /midas-retro skill
features.description: Read-only retrospective skill listed in docs/skills.md and passing skill-quality-check.
acceptance_criteria: WHEN a user invokes /midas-retro after a sprint, the skill SHALL produce a frozen note under {runs}/ without mutating paths.state stage.
WHEN skill-quality-check runs, midas-retro SHALL have no hard fails.

features.title: Document installer update rebaseline
features.description: INSTALL.md names the update flow and cites the structural test that guards ownership-manifest rebaseline.
acceptance_criteria: WHEN a reader follows INSTALL.md update section, they SHALL find steps for create-midas --update and rebaseline behavior.
WHEN npm test runs, the cited installer:update or rebaseline test id SHALL exist and pass.
